webhooks.detail: List webhooks via REST (create/list per audience): fire on subscribe, unsubscribe, profile, cleaned, upemail, campaign events. Also batch webhooks.

evidence.quote: Create a new webhook for a specific list.

sandbox.detail: No dedicated sandbox/test mode found. Free Mailchimp plan (250 contacts) usable to test integrations.

rate_limits.summary: 10 simultaneous connections per user; 429 when exceeded; 120s timeout

evidence.quote: The Marketing API has a limit of 10 simultaneous connections.
This tool is used to auto-generate and publish both Mailchimp Marketing and Transactional client libraries.
We use the OpenAPI Specification (formerly known as Swagger) to describe each endpoint.
